newsitem.title: USA: Briggs & Stratton files $175mln debt offer.
newsitem.headline: Briggs & Stratton files $175mln debt offer.

text.p: Briggs & Stratton Corp filed Wednesday with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission to offer up to $175 million in debt securities.
Of those securities to be issued, the company will sell $75 million of notes due Sept. 15, 2002 and $100 million in notes due Sept. 15, 2007.
Underwriters for the offering are Credit Suisse First Boston and BancAmerica Securities Inc.
Proceeds from the sale, will be used to reduce outstanding debt used to partially finance the company's buyback of about $300 million of its outstanding common shares.
The companay said it will use about $127 million of available cash to finance the self-tender offer, as well.
The Wauwatosa, Wis.-based company makes air-cooled gasoline engines.
